post.description: Queue a `pending` run for a worker. Nothing executes in the request (D1).

A `pending` run becomes `cancelled`; a `running` one gets `cancel_requested` and the
worker stops it (D7). 409 if the run has already finished.
Run an AgentVersion synchronously. A failed run is still 201, with `status: failed`.
